overview: The City Council approved a resolution seeking a comprehensive litigation audit following a significant increase in legal claims, authorized utility infrastructure work on Riverside and Boston Avenues, and discussed a new home-sharing program for seniors.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions and Recognitions
items.summary: Approved resolutions recognizing Black History Month, celebrating various cultural and faith observances including Lunar New Year, Ramadan, and Lent, and designating April 30th as National Therapy Animal Day.

items.title: Minutes and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the minutes of February 3, 2026, while tabling the January 21 joint meeting records, and approved several committee reports covering ambulance services, compensation ordinances, and public engagement strategies.

items.title: Public Hearing 26025: National Grid Electric Petition - Swan Street
items.summary: Tabled the petition for an electric pole installation until the next meeting because no representative was available to answer previous questions.

items.title: Public Hearing 26037: National Grid Gas Main - Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved the replacement of 1,420 feet of gas main to facilitate MWRA water line work, with the condition that the roadway be repaved curb-to-curb.

items.title: Public Hearing 26041: National Grid Conduit - Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved an 1,100-foot conduit installation to serve a new Tufts University building, with conditions regarding traffic management and a preference for minimizing night work near residents.

items.title: Business License Approvals
items.summary: Approved common victualler license transfers for Lighthouse Cafe and Coldstone Creamery, the latter of which was amended to allow operation until 11:00 PM daily.

items.title: Resolution 26043: Litigation Reports and Independent Review
items.summary: Approved a resolution demanding a comprehensive six-year litigation report and an independent audit of legal practices following a 573% increase in unfair labor practice charges since 2019. The resolution was amended to include a request for data on insurance premiums and a breakdown of outside counsel invoices regarding private investigators.

items.title: Infrastructure and Utility Communication Resolutions
items.summary: Approved requests for the DPW to provide briefings on major utility projects and to enhance public notification processes regarding construction timelines and winter moratoriums.

items.title: Resolution 26046: Home Sharing Implementation Plan
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide an implementation plan for a senior home-sharing program intended to increase affordable housing units without new construction.

items.title: Fiscal Appropriations and Donation Acceptance
items.summary: Approved a $10,000 Community Preservation Act appropriation for an invasive plant inventory and accepted an $800 donation for a specific veteran's housing needs.

items.title: Civil Service and Board Appointments
items.summary: Tabled a request to remove the Police Chief and Deputy positions from Civil Service and tabled all new board and commission appointments until formal resumes and the appointees are presented to the Council.

items.title: Executive Session: Hassett v. City of Medford
items.summary: The Council entered executive session to discuss litigation strategy regarding a claim by Liberty Mutual Insurance Company and adjourned directly thereafter.
